notes: Only PrimeMover and Synergist roles are exported; antagonist and stabiliser rows are omitted.
Ipsilateral/Contralateral are relative to the side of the muscle: rotating the head to the LEFT uses left-side "same side" rotators and right-side "opposite side" rotators.
nameSv is the Latin anatomical name (the standard term in Swedish anatomy); commonNameSv is a Swedish vernacular name where one is in common use (please proofread), otherwise null.
noSvg=true: muscle is not drawn on the body map yet.
